quarterly_data.quarter: X-Energy press release: Centrica, X-energy Advance Nuclear Plans as UK Regulators (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: UK: the UK Government directed regulators to accept the Xe-100 into the Generic Design Assessment, an approximately three-year review by the Office for Nuclear Regulation, the Environment Agency and Natural Resources Wales. Under their partnership, Centrica and X-energy intend to deploy up to 6 GW of new nuclear capacity in the UK (10-20 Xe-100 power stations), starting at Hartlepool; they have submitted a proposal for the UK Government's Advanced Nuclear Pipeline (results expected imminently) and engaged firms for site studies and consenting.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 6 GW (10-20 Xe-100 power stations); GDA about three years
